# Super Mario Galaxy AP - V0.0.1 - The initial release

## New
galaxy_shuffle: Swap galaxies around to any spot in the game. Also separated into groups such as Bosses or Observatory Specials.

Randomize the domes (Terrace, Fountain, etc.) exteriors around.

Control Final Star Count AND Counts per galaxy / in the domes.

star_colors show you if the level is progression (yellow), trap (red) filler (green), useful (blue). Once collected, the stars will change to transparent. If disabled it will act as vanilla.

hide_galaxy: Hide the galaxy models if you prefer on dome orbit screen. See option description for more details. 

Randomize Mario’s main color scheme. Won’t affect power ups currently or Luigi’s colors

Hungry Lumas should appear when their relevant domes are available.

## Randomizer Notes:
You start in the observatory, the first level is skipped. When you find the gateway, you can then select and play that level.

UT/Deathlink Support

Mario and Luigi can be interchanged as soon as save file is made. Each character still has its own save.

Receiving Grand stars unlocks a new dome,but you'll need to save and quit, enter dome and exit, or load level and leave to the observatory to "Reload" itself with the new dome you just unlocked.

1 green star unlocks the green planetoid in the observatory to all three green star planets.

Final Galaxy is not shuffled and after receiving 6 grand stars, your final star count required will update on the floor like it does in base game. 

Special thanks to: SomeJakeGuy, Bonk / Fl-ppie, Démorck, BootsinSoots, and Squidy for all their hard work on this first release.

smg-V0.0.2.description:
# Super Mario Galaxy AP - v0.0.2 The Hungry Luma Update

## New features
- ```observatory_hungry_luma_behavior``` and ```observatory_luma_counts``` new settings that allow you to control the amount of star bits lumas in the observatory require.
- Both Luma Counts and Dome Offsets now support random values instead of only integers. See the yaml option descriptions for more details.
- Dolphin now auto-launches when opening the client. If Dolphin is already open, then it will not open a new window.
- If you click open patch, it will also automatically launch the newly patched iso file as well.
- Similar to other Dolphin games, we now support "Multiple Dolphin" windows being open. For more details, see this message from the Luigi's Mansion channel: https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1378465872917827614/1479597055453434080


## Bug fixes
- DeathLink now kills the player properly when DeathLink is received.
- Luigi now appears all the time in his corresponding stars.
- Turning on death_link in the yaml will now set the tags upon connecting.
- Fixed an error where star counts were going higher than intended and creating patch errors.
- New patching errors if North American ROM ISO is not provided.


## Known bugs
- Toy Time 4 planet not showing up, can be solved by feeding luma in Toy Time 6
